title: Surface
description: What is under review: the lines a violation may be reported against, a selection of the change set numbered against its head commit. On a first-time review the whole change set; on a subsequent review the changes carrying an unresolved comment, carrying a comment the author resolved since the prior review, or new since the prior review

files.description: The lines a violation may be reported against

FileUnderReview.description: The lines of one file a violation may be reported against, by number only: added ranges numbered at the head commit, removed ranges at the base

SurfaceRange.description: Consecutive lines of the surface, the only lines a violation anchors on; a range of the change set that the surface does not list is not one
